summary:
ETH Zurich/UZH and EPFL lead research and spin-offs, with ZHAW/HES institutions, IDSIA, Idiap and CSEM extending applied expertise across Switzerland.
Capital flows through Founderful, Verve, Swisscom Ventures, bank/deep-tech programs and foreign robotics investors; grants and founder funding are not automatically available to a French student association.
Demand centers on industrial and infrastructure inspection, logistics, precision agriculture, surgical/rehabilitation systems and laboratory automation; safety and integration requirements remain substantial.
42AI's best first contacts are ETH Robotics Club, Robopoly, CVRA and accessible makerspaces; pair small-arm demos with LASA/Idiap open software and scoped technical feedback.
Low-cost imitation learning/VLAs are a hypothesis for learning and visibility, not a proven moat: compare against scripted baselines, measure recovery/data costs, and avoid expensive hardware before validating a task.
